categories.main_business_segments: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, development, production, sales, and service of five-axis CNC machine tools, high-end CNC systems, key functional components, and flexible automation production lines. Its product portfolio includes four general-purpose five-axis machining centers (vertical, horizontal, gantry, and horizontal milling-turning composite), four specialized machining centers (tool grinding, blade machining, high-speed tip grinding, and six-axis five-linkage blade machining centers), high-end CNC systems, servo drives, motors, sensors, electric spindles, milling heads, and rotary tables. The company also provides turnkey flexible automation production line solutions integrating machine tools, fixtures, tools, logistics, and control systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies including high-end CNC system technology, general and specialized five-axis CNC machine tool technology, direct-drive functional components, high-performance servo drive systems, high-precision sensing and detection, and high-performance torque and spindle motors. It emphasizes modular, platform-based design and integrates advanced manufacturing techniques such as direct-drive motors, high-precision laser interferometry, and multi-axis coordinated control. Production follows an order-driven model with strict quality control and partial outsourcing of non-core processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KEDE serves key industries including aerospace, aviation, military, energy, automotive, machinery, tooling, electronics, and medical devices. Its customers include manufacturers of aircraft engines, satellites, rockets, precision molds, automotive parts (notably new energy vehicles), and cutting tools. The company has strong market penetration in aerospace and military sectors, with growing presence in civilian sectors such as automotive and energy. Major customers contribute significantly to revenue, with the top five accounting for over 58% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with key sales regions including Northeast China, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest China, and Southwest China. It also actively expands overseas markets through participation in international exhibitions and collaborations. Production facilities are located in Dalian, Chongqing, Shaanxi, Ningxia, and Shenyang, supporting nationwide manufacturing and R&D activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: KEDE operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the CNC machine tool supply chain. It designs and manufactures complete five-axis CNC machine tools and key functional components such as CNC systems, motors, and sensors. The company also provides integrated automation production lines, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider from core components to finished equipment and system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes independent innovation and core technology development to achieve import substitution in high-end CNC machine tools and systems. R&D focuses on enhancing five-axis machining capabilities, developing new specialized machining centers (e.g., six-axis blade machining), improving CNC system performance, and advancing direct-drive components. It actively participates in national and provincial research projects, holds numerous patents, and emphasizes engineering application and rapid product iteration. Future R&D includes expanding product lines for aerospace, automotive, tooling, and medical sectors, and enhancing flexible automation solutions.
categories.revenue_model: KEDE generates revenue primarily through the sale of high-end five-axis CNC machine tools, high-end CNC systems, key functional components, and flexible automation production lines. Sales are recognized at the point of control transfer, typically upon delivery and installation acceptance for machine tools, and upon delivery for components. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by authorized distributors, with additional income from after-sales technical services and turnkey project solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with established international CNC machine tool manufacturers such as Haas (USA), Mazak (Japan), DMG Mori (Germany/Japan), FANUC (Japan), and others. Domestically, it is among the few firms with dual R&D capabilities in high-end CNC systems and machine tools, positioning itself as a leading innovator in China's high-end CNC market. KEDE has a significant market share in five-axis vertical machining centers and is recognized for its import substitution capabilities and comprehensive product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, KEDE achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 452 million, a 43.37% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 102 million, up 69.01%. The company’s gross margin improved to 46.03%, and cash flow from operations turned positive at RMB 44.57 million. It has a registered capital of RMB 93.18 million and total assets nearing RMB 1.5 billion, reflecting steady growth driven by expanding orders and production capacity. R&D investment accounted for over 33% of revenue, underscoring its innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KEDE emphasizes high precision, high efficiency, and high reliability in its five-axis CNC machine tools, supported by proprietary high-end CNC systems and key functional components. Its products enable complex multi-axis machining with superior dynamic response and accuracy, tailored for aerospace, military, automotive, and tooling industries. The company offers high cost-performance ratios compared to imported alternatives, rapid technical support, and integrated turnkey automation solutions. Its dual R&D system and comprehensive product ecosystem provide customers with customized, flexible manufacturing solutions and strong after-sales service.
